snippet.title: Greedy Bird Game - Ravenous Greed Reveal Trailer!
snippet.description:
We are proud to debut the reveal trailer for our next game: Ravenous Greed. Ravenous Greed is the first game in Lillymo Games' Green Series.

Wishlist now on Steam and play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4685120/Ravenous_Greed/
